# FORCE DATA IMPORTS

```{r FT2 force_data_import}

# create a list of data frames
df_list = list()

# processed force profile pathdir
profile_path = "../../../data/processed/excavation_data/processed_force_profiles/prop_adair/"

# Grab all paths of force profiles
file_names = dir(profile_path)

# Read all force files into a list
for(file_name in file_names){
        path = paste(profile_path, file_name, sep='')
        df = fread(file = path)
        df_list[[file_name]] = df
}

# Clean up extra variables
rm(file_name, file_names, profile_path, path, df)
```

```{r FT2 peak_force_values}
# Loop through each data frame in the list
# And extract the peak forces
# Create an empty data frame with names and column types
df_force = data.frame(
        sys_id = character(0),        # Root System ID
        ang45_ang = numeric(0),       # Largest angle <= 45 deg (usually around 44 due to measurement intervals)
        ang45_n = numeric(0),         # Measured force (N) at 45 deg
        peak_ang = numeric(0),        # Angle at which the peak force occurred
        peak_n = numeric(0),          # Peak force measured
        peak45_ang = numeric(0),      # Angle of the maximum force between 90 and 45 deg
        peak45_n = numeric(0),        # Peak force (N) from the interval between 90 and 45 deg
        std_trunk_moment = numeric(0) # Critical turning moment (torque, N*m) measured at the peak observed force
)

# populate the data frame with force data
for(name in names(df_list)){
        ang45_idx = min(which(df_list[[name]]$ang_y <= 45))
        ang45_row = df_list[[name]][ang45_idx,]

        peak_idx = which.max(df_list[[name]]$std_trunk_effort_n)
        peak_row = df_list[[name]][peak_idx,]
        
        peak45_idx = which.max(df_list[[name]][1:ang45_idx]$std_trunk_effort_n)
        peak45_row = df_list[[name]][peak45_idx,]

        df_force <- df_force %>%
                add_row(
                        tibble_row(
                                sys_id=substr(toupper(name), start=1, stop=nchar(name)-4),
                                ang45_ang=ang45_row$ang_y,
                                ang45_n=ang45_row$std_trunk_effort_n,
                                peak_ang=peak_row$ang_y,
                                peak_n=peak_row$std_trunk_effort_n,
                                peak45_ang=peak45_row$ang_y,
                                peak45_n=peak45_row$std_trunk_effort_n,
                                std_trunk_moment=peak_row$std_trunk_moment
                        )
                )
}

# Clean up extra variables
rm(name, ang45_idx, ang45_row, peak_idx, peak_row, peak45_idx, peak45_row, df_list)
```

# FT1 AND FT2 RADIAL DENSITY MAPS

```{r FT1 and FT2 radial_density_map_filenames}
# Set the directory of all the radial density csv files
dens_dir = "../../../data/processed/radial_img_processing_results/"

# Initialize empty filename vectors and fill 
ft1_rad_filenames <- c()
ft2_rad_filenames <- c()

for(file_name in dir(dens_dir)){
        ft1_bool = str_detect(file_name, "^\\d{2}_\\d{2}")
        ft2_bool = str_detect(file_name, "^\\d{2}[EW]+")
        
        if(ft1_bool){
                ft1_rad_filenames <- c(ft1_rad_filenames, file_name)
        } else if(ft2_bool){
                ft2_rad_filenames <- c(ft2_rad_filenames, file_name)
        }
}

# Clean up extra variables
rm(ft1_bool, ft2_bool, file_name)
```

```{r FT1 radial_density_maps}
# Start an empty list for radial densities
ft1_rad_den_list = list()

# Loop over all density files, populate the df and add to list
for(file_name in ft1_rad_filenames){
        path = paste(dens_dir, file_name, sep='')
        rad_den_df = fread(path) %>% 
                arrange(radius, angle)
        row = str_extract(file_name, '^\\d{2}')
        tree = str_extract(file_name, '(?<=^\\d{2}_)\\d{2}')
        sys_id = paste(row, tree, sep="_")
        ft1_rad_den_list[[sys_id]] <- rad_den_df

}

# Grab the full radius/angle map
degrees_radius_map <- rad_den_df[,3:4]

# Set up an empty matrix and label list
ft1_den_mat <- matrix(nrow=0, ncol=2700)
ft1_sys_id_labels = names(ft1_rad_den_list)

# Loop over each df in the density list
# Extract the densities as a vector
# Row bind to the matrix and append system name to labels vec
for(idx in names(ft1_rad_den_list)){
        vec <- as.vector(ft1_rad_den_list[[idx]]$density)
        ft1_den_mat <- rbind(ft1_den_mat, vec)
        # ft1_sys_id_labels <- c(ft1_sys_id_labels, idx)
}

# Bind radial densities to system IDs
ft1_rad_den_df <- data.frame(sys_id=ft1_sys_id_labels) %>% 
        cbind(ft1_den_mat)
colnames(ft1_rad_den_df)[2:2701] <- paste("D", as.character(1:2700), sep=".")

# Clean up extra variables
rm(ft1_rad_den_list, file_name, path, rad_den_df, row, tree, sys_id, idx, vec, ft1_den_mat, ft1_sys_id_labels)
```

```{r FT2 radial density maps}
# Start an empty list for radial densities
ft2_rad_den_list = list()

# Loop over all density files, populate the df and add to list
for(file_name in ft2_rad_filenames){
```

```{r Shannon Equitability Index}

shannon_eq <- function(df, eps=1e-32){
        n = ncol(df)
        row_sums = rowSums(df)
        props <- as.matrix(sweep(df, 1, row_sums, FUN="/"))
        props <- ifelse(props==0, eps, props)
        shannon_eq <- -rowSums(props * log(props)) / log(n) # Calculate the index and then normalize
        
        # Return the index
        shannon_eq
}

shannon_eq2 <- function(df, eps=1e-32){
        sys_id <- df$sys_id
        df_t <- cbind(degrees_radius_map, t(df[, 2:2701]))
        colnames(df_t)[3:length(colnames(df_t))] <- sys_id
        means_long <- df_t %>% 
                pivot_longer(cols=3:length(df_t), names_to = 'sys_id', values_to = 'density') %>% 
                group_by(sys_id, angle) %>% 
                summarize(density = mean(density))
        
        means_wide <- means_long %>% 
                pivot_wider(names_from = 'angle', values_from = 'density') %>% 
                ungroup() %>% 
                dplyr::select(-sys_id)
        
        n = ncol(means_wide)
        row_sums = rowSums(means_wide)
        props <- as.matrix(sweep(means_wide, 1, row_sums, FUN="/"))
        props <- ifelse(props==0, eps, props)
        shannon_eq <- -rowSums(props * log(props)) / log(n) # Calculate the index and then normalize
        
        # Return the index
        shannon_eq
        # means_wide
}

ft1_shannon <- shannon_eq(ft1_rad_den_df[, 2:2701])
ft2_shannon <- shannon_eq(ft2_rad_den_df[, 2:2701])

ft1_shannon <- data.frame(
        sys_id=ft1_rad_den_df$sys_id,
        sh_eq=ft1_shannon
        )

ft2_shannon <- data.frame(
        sys_id=ft2_rad_den_df$sys_id,
        sh_eq=ft2_shannon
        )
```

## Join all FT2 force data to other growth and measurement data
```{r join forces to metadata}
# Read in growth data
growth <- fread('../../../data/raw/tree_growth/prop_adair_tree_growth_data.csv') %>% 
        filter(t==2)
# Read in root system level measurements
sys_measurement <- fread('../../../data/raw/whole_root_system_measurements/prop_adair_root_system_measurement.csv')
# root_summaries <- fread('../../../data/processed/root_measurements/prop_adair_root_measurement_summary.csv')
# Read in root segment summaries
root_summaries <- fread('../../../data/processed/root_measurements/prop_adair_root_measurement_aggregated.csv')
# Read in root sysem  depth summaries
depth_summaries <- fread('../../../data/processed/cleaned_data/prop_adair_system_depths.csv')

# Merge in the force profile results
force_results <- df_force %>% 
        left_join(ft1_meta, by='sys_id') %>%
        dplyr::select(-comment) %>% 
        left_join(growth, by='sys_id') %>% 
        dplyr::select(-ends_with(".y")) %>% 
        left_join(sys_measurement, by='sys_id') %>% 
        dplyr::select(-ends_with(".x")) %>% 
        left_join(root_summaries, by='sys_id') %>%
        dplyr::select(-ends_with(".x")) %>% 
        dplyr::select(-ends_with(".y")) %>% 
        left_join(depth_summaries, by='sys_id') %>% 
        dplyr::select(-ends_with(".x")) %>% 
        dplyr::select(-ends_with(".y")) %>% 
        dplyr::select(sys_id, plot_id, row, tree, plot, block, rs:plant_date, measurement_date, t, direction, everything()) %>% 
        dplyr::select(-c(comment)) %>% 
        dplyr::filter(sys_id != "17W_28") %>% # Get rid of replacement tree
        rowwise() %>% 
        mutate(can_dia_cm = mean(c_across(starts_with("can"))),
               rs_r_cm = rs_cm / (2 * pi),
               tcsa = pi * rs_r_cm^2,
               tcsa_peak_force = peak45_n / tcsa,
               tcsa_ctm = std_trunk_moment / tcsa)
               
# Subset just the numerical data
num_data <- force_results %>% 
        # dplyr::select(-c(1:6, 9:14, ang45_ang, peak_ang, peak45_ang)) %>% 
        rowwise() %>% 
        mutate(can_dia_cm = mean(c_across(starts_with("can"))))

force_results$prop_type <- factor(force_results$prop_type, labels=c("Cutting", "Micropropagation", "Seedling"))
write.csv(force_results, "../../../data/processed/excavation_data/peak_force_tree_measurements.csv")

# Clean up extra variables
rm(growth, sys_measurement, root_summaries, depth_summaries)
```

```{r radial image data import}
# Pixel area to cm2 area conversion
# Pixel per 30cm
SCALE = 1393 # Pixels per cm
CONV_FACTOR = 30^2 / SCALE^2 # Conversion factor to cm^2


# Read in the radial data
radial_image_data <- fread("../../../data/processed/radial_img_processing_results/prop_adair_image_results.csv") %>% 
        dplyr::select(-V1) %>% 
        mutate(convex_hull_area_cm2 = convex_hull_area * CONV_FACTOR,
               root_area_cm2 = root_area * CONV_FACTOR)


# Process FT1 data
ft1_radial_data <- radial_image_data[145:263,] %>% 
        separate(image_name, into = c('row', 'tree', NA)) %>% 
        mutate(sys_id=paste(row, tree, sep="_")) %>% 
        dplyr::select(-c(row, tree)) %>% 
        left_join(ft1_meta, by='sys_id') %>% 
        dplyr::select(sys_id, plot_id:comment, everything()) %>% 
        dplyr::select(-c(row, tree, plot, plant_date, rhizotron, tube_no, comment)) %>% 
        full_join(ft1_shannon)
ft1_radial_data$prop_type <- factor(ft1_radial_data$prop_type, labels=c("Cutting", "Micropropagation", "Seedling"))

# Process FT2 data
ft2_radial_data <- radial_image_data[1:144,] %>% 
        separate(image_name, into = c('img_id', NA), sep = "_") %>% 
        mutate(tree=str_sub(img_id, start=1, end=2),
               row=paste("17", str_sub(img_id, start=3, end=3), sep = ""),
               sys_id=paste(row, tree, sep="_")) %>% 
        dplyr::select(-c(img_id, row, tree)) %>% 
        left_join(ft2_meta, by='sys_id') %>% 
        dplyr::select(sys_id, plot_id:comment, everything()) %>% 
        dplyr::select(-c(row, tree, plot, plant_date, rhizotron, tube_no, comment)) %>% 
        full_join(ft2_shannon) # Join the Shannon Eq index
ft2_radial_data$prop_type <- factor(ft2_radial_data$prop_type, labels=c("Cutting", "Micropropagation", "Seedling"))

# Recombine them
combined_radial_data <- bind_rows(list('ft1'=ft1_radial_data, 'ft2'=ft2_radial_data), .id = 'trial')
combined_radial_data$trial <- factor(combined_radial_data$trial, labels=c("FT1", "FT2"))

# Clean up extra variables
rm(SCALE, CONV_FACTOR, ft1_shannon, ft2_shannon, radial_image_data)
```


# Radial Data Mixed Modeling
## Convex Hull
```{r radial convex hull mixed models}
# Mixed model
ft1_convexhull_mm <- lmer(convex_hull_area_cm2 ~ rs * prop_type + (1|block), data=ft1_radial_data)
ft2_convexhull_mm <- lmer(convex_hull_area_cm2 ~ rs * prop_type + (1|block), data=ft2_radial_data)

# ANOVA
anova(ft1_convexhull_mm)
anova(ft2_convexhull_mm)

# Random Effects
as.data.frame(VarCorr(ft1_convexhull_mm))
as.data.frame

# EMMEANS
ft1_convexhull_mm_emm <- emmeans(ft1_convexhull_mm, specs = c(~rs, ~prop_type, ~rs*prop_type))
ft2_convexhull_mm_emm <- emmeans(ft2_convexhull_mm, specs = c(~rs, ~prop_type, ~rs*prop_type))

# CLD reports
ft1_rs_cld = cld(ft1_convexhull_mm_emm$`emmeans of rs`, Letters = letters, reversed = T) %>% 
        arrange(rs)
ft1_prop_cld = cld(ft1_convexhull_mm_emm$`emmeans of prop_type`, Letters = letters, reversed = T) %>% 
        arrange(prop_type)
ft1_rs_prop_cld = cld(ft1_convexhull_mm_emm$`emmeans of rs, prop_type`, Letters = letters, reversed = T) %>% 
        arrange(prop_type, rs)


ft2_rs_cld = cld(ft2_convexhull_mm_emm$`emmeans of rs`, Letters = letters, reversed = T) %>% 
        arrange(rs)
ft2_prop_cld = cld(ft2_convexhull_mm_emm$`emmeans of prop_type`, Letters = letters, reversed = T) %>% 
        arrange(prop_type)
ft2_rs_prop_cld = cld(ft2_convexhull_mm_emm$`emmeans of rs, prop_type`, Letters = letters, reversed = T) %>% 
        arrange(prop_type, rs)

ft1_rs_cld
ft1_prop_cld
ft1_rs_prop_cld

ft2_rs_cld
ft2_prop_cld
ft2_rs_prop_cld

as.data.frame(VarCorr(ft1_convexhull_mm))
as.data.frame(VarCorr(ft2_convexhull_mm))
```

```{r Growth Data Correlation Analysis}
# Correlation plots for growth data
# Subset specific growth columns
subset_columns = c(
        "peak45_n",
        "rs_cm",
        "sc_cm",
        "height_cm",
        "can_dia_cm"
)

ggpairs_df = force_results[subset_columns]
# Rename columns
colnames(ggpairs_df) <- c("Peak Force (N)", "RS Circ. (cm)", "SC Circ. (cm)", "Tree Height (cm)", "Canopy Dia. (cm)")
# Correlation plot
growth_cor_graph = ggpairs(
        ggpairs_df, 
        lower = list(continuous = wrap("points", size=2, alpha=0.5, color="navy"), combo = "dot_no_facet"),
        diag = list(continuous = "densityDiag"),
        progress = FALSE
        # mapping = ggplot2::aes(color=force_results$rs)
) +
        theme_minimal()+
        theme(strip.text = element_text(size=8))+
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45))+
        theme()

growth_cor_graph

growth_cor_mat <- cor_mat(ggpairs_df)
growth_cor_pmat <- cor_pmat(ggpairs_df)

growth_cor_matrix <- matrix(data=NA, nrow=nrow(growth_cor_mat), ncol=ncol(growth_cor_mat)-1)
rownames(growth_cor_matrix) = growth_cor_mat$rowname
colnames(growth_cor_matrix) = colnames(growth_cor_mat)[-1]


for (i in 1:nrow(growth_cor_mat)) {
        for (j in 2:ncol(growth_cor_mat)) {
                corr = growth_cor_mat[i,j]
                pvalue = growth_cor_pmat[i,j]
                if ((pvalue > 0.05) | (corr == 1)) {
                        signif = ""
                } else if (pvalue > 0.01) {
                        signif = "*"
                } else if (pvalue > 0.001){
                        signif = "**"
                } else {
                        signif = "***"
                }
                entry = trimws(paste(corr, signif, sep=" "))
                growth_cor_matrix[i,j-1] = entry
        }
}
growth_cor_matrix

write.csv(growth_cor_matrix, "growth_correlation_matrix.csv")

# Cleanup
rm(subset_columns, ggpairs_df, growth_cor_mat, growth_cor_pmat, growth_cor_matrix)
```

## PLS Modeling
```{r plsr modeling}
library(Metrics)

# Grab the quadrant density information and the growth/root information and append
plsr_data = num_data %>%
        select(-(2:21), -load_depth_px, -(h_e:can_dia_cm), -c(tcsa, tcsa_ctm)) %>% # Drop unnecessary columns
        left_join( # Grab the CHA, solidity, and ASI
                ft2_radial_data %>% 
                        dplyr::select(sys_id, convex_hull_area, solidity, asi, sh_eq)
                , 'sys_id'
        ) %>% 
        right_join(density_df, by = 'sys_id') %>% # Pull in the density measurements at the end
        select(-c(sys_id, seg_angle, ang45_ang:peak45_ang, std_trunk_moment)) %>%
        # select(peak45_n, everything())
        select(tcsa_peak_force, everything())
plsr_data = plsr_data[-136,] # Get rid of the replacement tree


# plsr_data <- density_df %>% 
#         dplyr::select(7:2707)

# Grab target y
y = plsr_data$tcsa_peak_force
# y = plsr_data$peak45_n

# Scale all independents (minus the target) and then add the target back in
plsr_data = as.data.frame(scale(plsr_data[, -1])) %>% 
        mutate(peak45_n = y) %>% 
        select(peak45_n, everything())

# Set up the PLSR formula as col1 ~ everything()
pls_formula <- formula(plsr_data)

# Get an empty vector to hold the RMSE scores
rmse_scores = c()

# Loop through different numbers of components
# for (i in 1:30) {
#         print(i)
#         peak_pls <- plsr(pls_formula, ncomp = i, data = plsr_data, validation="LOO")
#         preds = predict(peak_pls, plsr_data[, -1])
#         error = rmse(y, preds)
#         rmse_scores = c(rmse_scores, error)
#         print(rmse_scores)
# }

peak_pls <- plsr(pls_formula, ncomp=10, data=plsr_data, validation="LOO")
coef_df <- as.data.frame(coef(peak_pls, ncomp=1))
colnames(coef_df) <- c('coef')
coef_df

dens_coef_df <- as.data.frame(coef_df[39:nrow(coef_df),])
colnames(dens_coef_df) <- c('coef')
dens_coef_df
# plot(rmse_scores)
# plot(peak_pls)
# plot(peak_pls, ncomp = 1,plottype = "coef")
# plot(peak_pls, plottype = "correlation")
# plot(explvar(peak_pls))
# plot(cumsum(explvar(peak_pls)))
```

## PLS Coefficient Smoothing and FFT
```{r}

raw_coef_plot <- ggplot(dens_coef_df, aes(x=1:nrow(dens_coef_df), y = coef))+
        geom_line(alpha=0.8)+
        labs(x='Index', y='PLS Coef.')+
        theme_minimal()

raw_coef_plot

# Fit a baseline spline
y <- dens_coef_df$coef # y = coef
x <- seq_along(y) # x = index
spline_fit <- smooth.spline(x, y, df=8)

# Set the baseline and mutate dens_coef_df
baseline <- predict(spline_fit, x)$y # Use the spline to predict all 2700 indices
dens_coef_df <- dens_coef_df %>% 
        mutate(baseline = baseline, 
               centered_coef = coef - baseline,
               smoothed_coef = smth.gaussian(centered_coef, window = 15),
               slice = rep(1:90, times=30)*4,
               radius = rep(1:30, each=90))

baseline_coef_plot <- ggplot(dens_coef_df, aes(x=1:nrow(dens_coef_df), y=coef))+
        geom_line(alpha=0.8)+
        geom_line(y=baseline, color='blue', lwd=1)+
        labs(x='Index', y='PLS Coef')+
        theme_minimal()

baseline_coef_plot

centered_coef_plot <- ggplot(dens_coef_df, aes(x=1:nrow(dens_coef_df), y=centered_coef))+
        geom_line(alpha=0.8)+
        labs(x='Index', y='PLS Coef.')+
        theme_minimal()

centered_coef_plot

smoothed_coef_plot <- ggplot(dens_coef_df[271:nrow(dens_coef_df),], aes(x=271:nrow(dens_coef_df), y=smoothed_coef))+
        geom_line()+
        labs(x='Index', y='PLS Coef.')+
        theme_minimal()

smoothed_coef_plot

aggregated_coef_plot <- ggplot(dens_coef_df[271:nrow(dens_coef_df),], aes(x=slice, y=smoothed_coef))+
        geom_point(color='blue', alpha=0.2)+
        geom_vline(xintercept = c(90, 180, 270))+
        scale_x_continuous(
                breaks=seq(0, 360, by=45), # start at halfway through the first slice
                labels=function(x) paste0(x, "°")
        )+
        labs(x='Degrees from Leeward', y='PLS Coef.')+
        theme_minimal()

aggregated_coef_plot


sub_coef <- dens_coef_df$smoothed_coef[271:(2700-90)]


# Fast Fourier Transform
coef_fft <- fft(sub_coef)
freqs <- seq(0, length(sub_coef)-1) / length(sub_coef)
power_spectrum <- Mod(coef_fft)^2  # Magnitude squared
plot(freqs, power_spectrum, type="h", main="FFT Power Spectrum", xlab="Frequency", ylab="Power")

# Grab the lower half of the frequencies
idx = which(freqs <= 0.5)
fft_df <- data.frame(freq=freqs[idx], spec=power_spectrum[idx])
ordered_df <- fft_df[order(-fft_df$spec),]
ordered_df$interval = 1/ordered_df$freq * 4

top_fft_df <- head(ordered_df, 10)
print(top_fft_df)

power_spectrum_plot <- ggplot(fft_df, aes(x=freq, y=spec))+
        geom_line()+
        xlim(0, 0.1)+
        theme_minimal()+
        geom_label(
                data=top_fft_df[c(1, 2, 3, 7, 8),], 
                aes(x=freq, y=-5, label=round(interval)), 
                inherit.aes=FALSE,
                size=2.5)+
        labs(x='Frequency',
             y='Power')#+
        # ylim(-8, 40)

power_spectrum_plot


smoothing_ggarrange_plot <- ggarrange(raw_coef_plot, baseline_coef_plot, centered_coef_plot, smoothed_coef_plot, aggregated_coef_plot, power_spectrum_plot, ncol=2, nrow=3, labels = 'AUTO')
smoothing_ggarrange_plot
```

```{r}
        ) +
        coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0, 0.1), ylim=c(-12, max(fft_df$spec))) +
        labs(x='Frequency (cycles/4°)', y='Spectral Power') +
        ggtitle("FFT Power Spectrum", subtitle = "Dominant frequencies in angular signal") +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 14)+
```
